description: This file defines API endpoints for managing vector stores in the Litellm project, including creation, listing, deletion, retrieval, and updating of vector stores via FastAPI routes.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Represents a managed vector store, used in API responses and registry.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse
classes.description: Response model for listing vector stores.

classes.name: ResponseLiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Response model for a single vector store details.

classes.name: VectorStoreDeleteRequest
classes.description: Request model for deleting a vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreInfoRequest
classes.description: Request model for retrieving vector store info.

classes.name: VectorStoreUpdateRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating vector store details.

methods.name: new_vector_store( vector_store: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new vector store, adds it to the registry, and handles database insertion.

methods.name: list_vector_stores( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
methods.description: Lists all managed vector stores, combining in-memory and database entries, with pagination.

methods.name: delete_vector_store( data: VectorStoreDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified vector store from database and registry.

methods.name: get_vector_store_info( data: VectorStoreInfoRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified vector store.

methods.name: update_vector_store( data: VectorStoreUpdateRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates details of an existing vector store in database and registry.

ctags.name: list_vector_stores
ctags.signature: ( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
